title: Robotaxi (Full City, No Safety Driver)
summary: Driverless taxi across entire metro without geofencing or safety driver
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Driverless taxi across entire metro without geofencing or safety driver.

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 17 independent sources on this technology.
